item.title: Oha
item.author: xxxx
item.description:
oha
https://github.com/hatoo/oha
Ohayou(おはよう), HTTP load generator, inspired by rakyll/hey with tui animation.

oha is a tiny program that sends some load to a web application and show realtime tui inspired by rakyll/hey.

This program is written in Rust and powered by tokio and beautiful tui by ratatui.

Installation Process:

item.title: Deno
item.author: xxxx
item.description:
Deno
https://deno.land
https://deno.town
https://github.com/denoland/deno

https://github.com/architect/architect

Deno is a brand new experimental JavaScript runtime and deno.town is a web based REPL with linting and code completion to help you explore and learn the API.
Why Deno?

It is very fast
Built in least privilege security
Standard esmodules
TypeScript, JSX and TSX dialects supported

How

AWS Lambda (and friends) by way of OpenJS Architect
Deployed continuously with begin.com (Note! We have not officially released Deno support. Keep reading if you are interested in that.)
